notes_for_editor: The register is the only source with specific data for this site. The Canada Lookouts page for Whitemud gives only a division heading (Peace River Division) and no dated entries. No history, staffing, fire, access or agency source was found. Brief's access 'closed' is not stated by any source, so no access level is recorded; the register's 'fly' code is quoted in the story as suggesting access by air, and no visit fact is recorded. Brief's agency 'Alberta Wildfire' is not named in any source read for this site and is left out. A search of Peace River area newspapers or Alberta archives might turn up history; none was read here.
